title: find_immutable_patch_key: /path-segment check is correct — prefix check alone would be wrong
description: The byte-index check (key.starts_with(field) && key.as_bytes().get(field.len()) == Some(&b'/')) correctly distinguishes 'messageId/' (blocked, sub-path) from 'messageIdX' (allowed, unrelated field that happens to share a prefix). A simple starts_with check would incorrectly block legitimate fields. This subtlety is critical for correct JSON Merge Patch handling.
